answer: Each reputation contribution decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained honest service rather than brief activity. In the EigenTrust matrix, a newly spawned sybil has negligible incoming trust and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify unsupported links into credible weight, leaving it below consensus thresholds. A grove of colluding accounts, even labeled violet or dune, cannot bypass this temporal and trust-graph barrier.
